bug_semantics: An authenticated user who can run a workflow can supply crafted Edit Image / Draw Text input. The node line-wraps that value and passes it unchanged to gm.drawText(). gm 1.23.1 encloses text in an MVG quoted string and escapes double quotes but not attacker-supplied backslashes. A backslash can therefore alter the escaping of a following quote, terminate the intended text primitive, and inject another MVG primitive, causing GraphicsMagick to make a blind outbound request to an attacker-selected address or open a local file.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable text-to-gm.drawText() data path is already present in the repository's 257-file parentless root commit 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa (message: 'Initial commit to release'). That commit is a public release import/aggregate, not a reconstructable smallest member change, so the true pre-public BIC and its parent cannot be identified from this repository history.

The public boundary object 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa has human author and committer Jan Oberhauser <jan.oberhauser@gmail.com>, message 'Initial commit to release', and no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, bot, or other AI marker, but that marker absence cannot be projected onto the unrecoverable pre-public member commit.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-233r-fpgw-fx8x describes the Draw Text MVG primitive injection and lists current affected/patched branch boundaries <1.123.69/>=1.123.69, <2.33.4/>=2.33.4, and <2.34.1/>=2.34.1. Its prose Patches paragraph still names older 1.123.67/2.31.5/2.32.1 releases; repository contents show those older releases did not contain the Draw Text escaping fix.

At 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa, `git show 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa:packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage.node.ts` shows attacker-controlled `text`, `const renderText = lines.join('\n')`, and `.drawText(positionX, positionY, renderText)`. The same commit's packages/nodes-base/package.json selects gm ^1.23.1.

Both history searches converge on the public root: `git log --all --follow -S'drawText(' --format='%H %P %s' -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` and the equivalent search for `const renderText = lines.join` report only the later directory move a7bb1463fba65cb0474a181fe541d91c9e821ea9 and root 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa. `git log -L 1312,1344:packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` likewise traces the sink back to that root; the a7bb1463 change is only a move and is not a BIC.

`git cat-file commit 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa` contains a tree, human author/committer, and message but no parent header or trailers. `git diff-tree --root --no-commit-id --name-only -r 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa | wc -l` returns 257, corroborating that this is the aggregate public-history boundary. There is therefore no immediate parent in the clone against which a true BIC can be verified.

The gm 1.23.1 sources reproduce the parser boundary: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aheckmann/gm/1.23.1/lib/drawing.js implements drawText as `text x,y ` plus escape(text), while https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aheckmann/gm/1.23.1/lib/utils.js implements escape as surrounding quotes plus `.replace(/"/g, '\"')`; it does not escape pre-existing backslashes.

`git show 3e4fb19caf73276a68b38d45d96b3da5baf7cab7 -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/test/EditImage.node.test.ts` directly closes the relevant sink on the 1.x line: it changes `lines.join('\n')` to `lines.join('\n').replaceAll('\\', '\\\\')`, adds regression cases proving backslashes are doubled before drawText(), enumerates installed fonts, and rejects a selected font not in that list. The commit is a public Bundle/1.x aggregate, but it itself contains the closing code change.

The 1.x version boundary is directly reproducible: tags n8n@1.123.68 and n8n@1.123.69 resolve to 67e50ebb0689dd587704aa533f35f51839f860f9 and 430e6e597ab43d2326aa11cd30fcf633766fca31. `git log --ancestry-path n8n@1.123.68..n8n@1.123.69` includes 3e4fb19caf73276a68b38d45d96b3da5baf7cab7; `git merge-base --is-ancestor` is false for 1.123.68 and true for 1.123.69. `git show` of the former tag has unescaped `lines.join('\n')`; the latter has replaceAll backslash doubling and the installed-font check.

The corresponding closing 2.x backports are 0405fc550f55051f6c459252f5860fa78d27ab80 for 2.33.x and 170cfc787015d352488f6b6403af07a74e95ca1d for 2.34.x. Ancestry checks place them outside n8n@2.33.3/n8n@2.34.0 and inside n8n@2.33.4/n8n@2.34.1 respectively. Mainline receives the same fix in ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0.

The older releases named in the advisory prose do not close this mechanism: n8n@1.123.67 contains 1cd2c5fb22a906058cc083c3af2d561ce7f4332d but `git show n8n@1.123.67:packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` still has unescaped `const renderText = lines.join('\n')`; n8n@2.31.5 and n8n@2.32.1 show the same unescaped statement. The July bundle validates output format, not Draw Text backslashes, so the current affected/patched tables and August commits define the actual closing boundary.

BIC-only marker check: the exact root boundary commit object, inspected with `git cat-file commit 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa`, has no AI trailer or bot identity. No AI conclusion is drawn from the August fix commits, their bot authors, or any later history because the protocol restricts AI evidence to the true BIC object.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the unescaped backslash at the application-to-MVG grammar boundary, not merely generic use of GraphicsMagick. The August 1.x fix commit and its 2.x backports directly harden that boundary, and tag ancestry plus tag contents establish the final version ranges despite stale older version numbers in the advisory prose. For origin, -S, -L, rename-following history, and direct root inspection all stop at a parentless initial release aggregate that already contains the vulnerable sink. Treating that 257-file import as the smallest true BIC would violate the protocol's prohibition on using squash/import aggregates, and treating its human identity and lack of trailers as evidence about an unavailable pre-public member commit would be unsound. This is therefore BLOCKED at a genuine public-history boundary rather than NOT_AI or an AI verdict.
remaining_gap: The pre-public source history from which root import 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa was assembled is absent. Closing the audit would require the actual smallest member commit that first introduced the unescaped Edit Image drawText sink, its immediate parent for absence verification, and that member commit's raw commit object for BIC-only AI-marker inspection.
